title: Planted q-ary Second-Moment Probe-Variance Bridge: Exact Two-Point Variance Law, Projective-Ray Covariance Localization, and Dual-Spike Concentration

theorems.name: Exact Two-Point Probe Variance Law for Planted Subspaces
theorems.statement: For any dimension-d subspace B in F_q^n and window W in F_q of size R, N_W(u; B) takes value q^(d-1) R on F_q^n \ B^perp (prob 1 - q^(-d)) and q^d * 1_(0 in W) on B^perp (prob q^(-d)), with exact variance Var_u[N_W(u; B)] = (q^d - 1) * (1_(0 in W) - R/q)^2.

theorems.name: Projective-Ray Covariance Localization and Zero Off-Ray Covariance
theorems.statement: For any b, b' in F_q^n \ {0} on distinct projective rays, Cov_u(1_(<b, u> in W), 1_(<b', u> in W)) = 0, so Var_u[N_W(u; B)] decomposes into the sum of L_d = (q^d - 1)/(q - 1) uncorrelated projective-ray variances.

theorems.name: Subspace vs Ray-Free Subset Variance Ratio and Off-Dual Flatness
theorems.statement: For any ray-free subset S in F_q^n \ {0} of size q^d - 1 and zero-free window W in F_q \ {0} of size R, Var_u[N_W(u; S)] = (q^d - 1)(R/q)(1 - R/q) and Var_u[N_W(u; B)] / Var_u[N_W(u; S)] = R / (q - R), while Var_(u not in B^perp)[N_W(u; B)] = 0.
